name: remind
info: send a reminder to yourself or another user
description:
### reminder time formats 

> specify when to receive a reminder by placing time at the beginning or end of your message 

#### relative time (in)
* `in 15m` / `in 2h 30m` - set a countdown delay using english or russian time units
* `supported units` - years (y, г), months (mo, мес), weeks (w, нед), days (d, дн), hours (h, ч), minutes (m, мин), seconds (s, сек)
* `examples` - `in 20m do homework`, `feed cat in 1h 30m`, `in 2 дня call bob` 

#### absolute time (on)
* `on 18:30` - set specific time today (automatically moves to tomorrow if time has already passed)
* `on 25.12.2026 15:00` - set exact date and time (dots or colons are allowed for time)
* `date styles` - `dd.mm.yyyy`, `dd.mm.yy`, or full date names like `25 december 2026` / `25 декабря 2026`
* `examples` - `on 19:00 gym`, `meeting on 15.05.2026 10:30`, `on 31 dec 23:59 happy new year` 

#### syntax rules
* `placement` - place time at the start (`in 5m test`) or at the end (`test in 5m`)
* `colons` - colon after keyword is optional (`in 10m` or `in: 10m`)
* `quotes` - optional quotes around time value (`in: "2h 30m" take a break`)
